name: Stormwind Rendezvous
label: Quest
description: Stormwind Rendezvous: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are to meet with Windsor at the gates of Stormwind.
What Windsor is about to unveil will shake the very foundation of the kingdom!
Do not attempt to venture there alone, friend. You must amass an army! Gather your compatriots. To arms!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Before we begin, I ask that you first gather an army. We face a dragon, after all!
